summary:
All eight QA-R7b findings were reproduced. Seven are fixed and re-checked. B-06 is partly rejected and got a cheap mitigation. Every gate is green on c50d58f.

B-02 was a bug, not tuning. In the Compatibility renderer, PROJECTION_MATRIX[1][1] is negative in the vertex stage, so every landmark glow got the safety cap instead of its own size. The fix uses abs() plus Arcade's _lm_glow profile and sizes. Measured at the Florianturm, 22:00: 15 red px against Arcade's 10 (before 232); on the Deck preset 17 against 16.

- **B-01:** picture and light layer are now mixed in display values. Elbphilharmonie facade 116.1 against Arcade 112.8 (before 144.5).
- **B-03:** a floodlit model now gets the floodlight as its own light. Bremer Dom 0.97 × Arcade.
- **B-04:** landmarks are mirrored exactly where Arcade mirrors its picture. All 143 landmarks of the network stand at Arcade's anchor (worst 0.15 m, before 37.8 m).
- **B-05:** procedural shapes have their main axis on the anchor and face their approach. Leipzig's dome is visible again.
- **B-06:** the skyline fades in 0.05 steps. The spikes QA saw are load noise.
- **B-07:** the shape cache is keyed on height_m alone.
- **B-08:** docs §18 corrected.

New render checks nacht_hell, flugfeuer (against Arcade's red pixels) and anstrahlung each caught its mutation: linear mix (B01), signed scale (B02), floodlight removed (M16, M17). Arcade golden is 20/20 and 17/17. Modern golden is 5/6: only modern_s4_mittel differs, at the Michel (looked at). Render checks 29/29, run_tests full green, sight and path --full green. Kiel–Hamburg and Bremen–Dortmund run without script errors, with the same ERGEBNIS as the base.

deviations: B-04: a plain prop standing as a landmark is mirrored where Arcade mirrors it (props/church on the left side, 23 cases). D24 literally says landmarks are never mirrored.

B-05: models and shapes face their approach (bearing from the road point 600 m before, at most 40 deg) instead of the road heading at the anchor. near_shift keeps every corner from coming nearer the road.
B-06: QA's spike did not reproduce as a skyline cost. Only the cheap 0.05 alpha step is implemented.
The glow safety cap is now 25 % of the depth (was 3 %). The 3 % cap only existed to hide the sign bug.
Flat-roof skyscraper lights now sit on the front roof edge. With Arcade's size, the parapet hid them in the roof's middle (Madrid showed no light).
The flugfeuer red-pixel test now uses QA's measure (r >= 110, 1.8 ratios). The red threshold also counts Arcade's own dot, whose core is pinkish.
The full run_tests started on b0130bd. The light-position commit c50d58f was then verified by the landmark filter tests, the full render check run and the golden checks.
contract_issues: D24 'Landmarks are never mirrored and not turned' conflicts with Arcade: Arcade mirrors props/church standing as a landmark, and with the road heading a turned shape shows its side wall in bends. Proposed §11.4 wording: mirror where Arcade mirrors the picture (no landmarks/* model ever), front to the approach, never nearer the road.

R7 acceptance 'within 5 % at 600 m on a straight approach' can be tested at only 3 approaches. It is now backed by a network-wide anchor unit test (143 landmarks, <= 0.15 m). In tight bends (Belgrade, Ada bridge) the whole picture sits about 100 px off Arcade even with look_gain 0 (A-3 kernel geometry).
A-18: modern_s4_mittel changes on purpose (Michel facing its approach). The assembly must regenerate tests/golden/modern_slice.*.
notes_for_next: RINT-M3: regenerate the Modern golden list after the merge (only the Michel in modern_s4_mittel, looked at). Write the D24 rule for landmarks into §11.4.

Owner of reflector.gdshader / lights.gd: line 21 uses PROJECTION_MATRIX[1][1] * VIEWPORT_SIZE.y in the vertex stage, which is negative / 0 in Compatibility. Use abs() and a viewport_h uniform as landmark.gdshader does (inferred from code, not measured).
R7c / props.gd owner: the dead far-landmark path is still there (as R7b reported).
QA-mid: look at night pictures on deck for Dortmund, Madrid and Hamburg. The Calais lighthouse lamp was never visible in a picture (hidden in all modes); find a free view.
AS6: put the main axis of models for the six procedural entries on the origin (as PROC_AXIS_Z does); +Z faces the approach; landmarks/* are never mirrored.
Kernel / curve parity: at the Belgrade Ada bridge, scene objects (pylon, church) sit about 100 px off Arcade with look_gain 0.
Perf: Kiel-Hamburg landmarks hook max 0.94 / 6.16 ms on head against 0.34 / 0.40 on base (single frames under load). Node creation measured 0.12 against 0.06 ms; worth one look on real hardware.
look_verdict:
Measured on llvmpipe at the High preset against Arcade and R7b in the same simulation state.

Now equal to Arcade (before worse):
- the Elbphilharmonie at night: Arcade's facade contrast, no longer washed out;
- the aviation lights of the Florianturm and Madrid: Arcade's small dot instead of a red blot;
- the Bremer Dom: Arcade's place (5 px instead of 63) and floodlit like Arcade, a little warmer and brighter.

Better than before and close to Arcade: the Leipzig near view (dome visible again where Arcade shows it) and Hannover (frontal, the warm dome glow at Arcade's size, slightly stronger).

Better than Arcade: by day the 3D shapes (Hannover, Leipzig, Dortmund) are plastic, where Arcade has flat drawings.

Not better than before:
- Belgrade near view: the church shows its front but still stands at the right frame edge, about 100 px from Arcade. The bridge pylon is shifted the same way, so the cause is the bend geometry. Since the main axis moved to the anchor, the front is 23 m nearer and the church looks slightly bigger.

Not verified:
- the Calais lighthouse lamp is hidden in every picture taken.

Missing: real landmark models (AS6). Modern is clearly better than Arcade only where 3D shapes stand. Picture landmarks are equal to Arcade, not better.
